svg.title: HerdBench: crowd signals, fact-checked
svg.desc: A tapestry of the real net positioning of the crowd, without market makers, in 30 markets over 305 days: blue where traders held more longs, red where they held more shorts. Beside it: HerdBench, crowd signals fact-checked; 2 of 7 signals passed.
svg.text: Funding rates, long/short ratios and more,
tested against the real positions of every
